description: What happened to a token over time. Charts: price, 1-minute candles, open interest, funding, long/short ratios, exchange net flow, exchange reserves and TVL. Events: large transfers, liquidations, signals, headlines and briefs, each with a timestamp. Default window: last 24 hours of events and 14 days of charts.

resolution.description: Optional chart bucket: 15m, 1h, 6h, raw (every row). Default auto: 15m up to 2 days, 1h up to 30 days, 6h beyond

series.description: Optional comma list of charts to include: price, candles, open_interest, funding, long_short, exchange_net_flow, reserves, tvl

since.description: Optional ISO-8601 time to start from, e.g. 2026-10-06T00:00:00Z

token.description: The token: a CoinGecko id (cardano, chainlink, solana), a symbol (BTC) or a contract address

name: get_token_timeline
title: Get token timeline
